Ashraf & Co

For over the years, Ashraf & Co has been fabricating and installing aluminium windows, doors and glass work across Karachi — from single shop fronts to full apartment-block facades. Every job is measured on site, fabricated to size and fitted by our own team.

Send us your project's measurements or a few photos on WhatsApp, and we'll get back to you with the right solution and a fair quotation.
